name: agentic-sdlc
description: AI-assisted SDLC pipelines for NATIVE MOBILE development (Android/Kotlin + iOS/Swift) in Claude Code. Stack Provider Pattern: the core owns the pipeline; platform plugins register themselves via stack.md profiles. Adapted from AratKruglik/claude-sdlc (MIT), stripped to native mobile.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Optional runtime dependency. Richer reasoning in BA (brainstorming), QA (test-driven-development), and architect agents (verification-before-completion). Pipeline degrades gracefully without it.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Optional external dependency (official Anthropic). Hooks-based in-session security review. Pipeline runs without it; the security phase still does a full mobile (MASVS) review.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Platform-agnostic SDLC orchestrator with stack-provider auto-discovery. Provides the pipeline-orchestrator skill (generic phases, review-loops, parallel groups, workflow discovery across plugins, file_glob/nested detection) plus 5 cost-tiered fallback agents (BA Opus/high, Dev Sonnet/medium, QA Sonnet/medium with iteration cap, Sec Opus/high platform-neutral baseline, Docs Haiku/low). Commands: /sdlc:start, /sdlc:doctor, /sdlc:list-stacks, /sdlc:batch, /sdlc:security-init.

plugins.name: android-plugin
plugins.description: Native Android stack provider (Kotlin + Gradle, aspect android, priority 300, auto-detected via Gradle-AND-Kotlin). Full specialized roster: android-ba (Opus), android-developer, android-reviewer, android-security (Opus, MASVS/MASTG), android-tester, android-qa, android-docs (Haiku), plus on-demand android-debugger/devops/cicd/aar. Plugin-resident rules, optional Obsidian vault (manage-vault skill), optional Android CLI advisory, ktlint/detekt + non-negotiable hooks. Workflow android-feature: BA->Dev->Review(<->Dev x3)->[Security||Test]->QA->Docs, auto-selected on Android projects.

plugins.name: ios-plugin
plugins.description: Native iOS stack provider (Swift/SwiftUI, priority 300, aspect ios; auto-detected via *.xcodeproj/*.xcworkspace/Package.swift). ios-architect (Sonnet/medium) + SwiftUI/architecture/data/navigation convention skills; agnostic phases delegate to core agents (iOS MASVS/MASTG injected). Host-capability aware (lint/build macOS-only); builds CI-deferred. STATUS: skeleton (Phase 4 TODOs).
